summary: A consequential operation commits in a durable write transaction: the store pins the pool's one connection, sets synchronous=FULL before BEGIN, verifies level 2, commits, then restores NORMAL or discards the connection. The commit syncs the WAL, so no post-commit TRUNCATE checkpoint runs and a WAL reader cannot fail the acknowledgement. CD-0050 D3 adds the bootstrap journal and worktree claim, predecessor import, and fold-guard recovery families; the fence entry points commit durably while the conformance harness still measures ordinary commits. D2's guarantee is unchanged; a WAL size backstop stays an open, measured follow-up.
title: A durable commit replaces the checkpoint barrier
